Trump TRIES NEW STUNT as others INSTANTLY FAIL
Trump is going Postal, and the US People who love their post office will suffer. Popok reports on Trump's plan to dismantle the independent postal service and have it report to his Commerce Secretary who has 0 experience in the area, or with managing 63,000 unionized employees, as the Postal Commission prepares to file a lawsuit for this unconstitutional power grab.
